podcast.body: John Philip Sousa was the composer of over 130 marches, along with many other musical pieces that continue to be used today. His work exemplifies the popular military music style of the late 19th and early 20th centuries. "Susa was the composer of over 130 of these marches, along with many other pieces of music that are still being used today."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Music vs Technology Over The Years
